overview: The School Committee held a special meeting to review and approve an updated Chapter 74 viability form for the new Medford High School project. The update was requested by the Massachusetts School Building Authority to provide current enrollment and timeline data.

items.title: Chapter 74 Viability Form Approval
items.summary: Approved the updated Chapter 74 viability form for the new Medford High School project, which incorporates current student enrollment, waitlist data, and updated timelines for vocational programs.

subject: Chapter 74 Viability Form Approval
